input.title: [Mobile] Keyboard closes when user interacts with disabled buttons.
input.body:
## Step to reproduce
1. Create a thought and add text
2. Create a subthought and add text
3. Verify that Swap button is enabled when caret is on the newly created subthought
4. Put the caret on the thought from step 1
5. Verify that keyboard stays open
6. Verify that Swap Parent button is disabled now
7. Tap the Swap Parent button

## Current behavior
Keyboard closes.
Note: Keyboard stays open if user taps the Swap Parent button when it is enabled.

**Video:**

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f25918f6-b09c-4fe4-a4e0-c13f4cb74a1e



## Expected behavior
Nothing should happen when user taps any disabled buttons.
Keyboard stays open refer to #3619
